headline: Iran's foreign trade against the ropes due to US naval blockade - World - ABC Color
summary: Iran is trying to redirect foreign trade by land and via the Caspian Sea, but alternative routes are not keeping up. Iranian imports and exports are collapsing.
why: A blockade of Iran's ports cuts exports of crude and other goods, affecting global oil supply and regional trade flows.
